CVE-2026-85013.title: CVE-2026-85013
CVE-2026-85013.description: _module_comgen_words_and_files() fed untrusted text (module names read off disk, LOADEDMODULES, MODULEPATH) straight into `compgen -W`, which performs a full unquoted-word expansion on its wordlist -- including command substitution -- as a normal, documented part of its behavior. A module name, loaded-module entry, or MODULEPATH component containing e.g. `$(...)` therefore ran arbitrary shell code the moment a user pressed Tab.
